[d0872] config | snapshotter.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `snapshotter.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

---

[d0115] config | snapshotter.enabled | version 4.x
# `snapshotter.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.enabled` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
enabled = true
```

# `snapshotter.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
threshold_percent = 75
```

QUESTION:
Which setting can I use to deactivate the backup mechanism that freezes the state of queues completely?

GROUND TRUTH ANSWER:
The setting `snapshotter.enabled`.

ANSWER TO GRADE:
In PaderQueue 4.x, set `snapshotter.enabled = false` under `[snapshotter]` in `paderqueue.toml`.

- "wrong": misses the essential information or contradicts the ground truth.
- If the ground truth says the documentation does not contain the information, the answer is "correct" only if it
  clearly says that the information is not available. Any concrete answer is "wrong".
